target_customer: Software product teams and developers who need user onboarding and in-app guidance
problem: Onboarding flows and in-app help are hard to build and maintain; Frigade first offered developer-friendly onboarding components, then an AI assistant that guides and acts for users.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for developers and product teams
product_category: Product onboarding and in-app AI assistant

founders.name: Eric Brownrout
previous_startups: Perform (AI plus coaching app for runners)

founders.name: Christian Mathiesen
previous_startups: Perform (AI plus coaching app for runners)
founders.background_notes: Helped launch LinkedIn skills-based hiring products (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Embeddable onboarding components for React are standard frontend work; the later AI agent that learns a product's interface is harder.

defensibility.rationale: Established no-code competitors existed and onboarding widgets were copyable, with integration into customer apps as the main lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition of Frigade found. A low-quality roundup claims Userflow was acquired by Appcues in 2024, unverified.

market_need_then: Onboarding is a widely recognized pain for software teams, and a funded market of no-code tools already existed; Frigade bet on developer-first code components. Launch coverage dated October 2023 on Product Hunt.

branding.name_origin: A blend of frigate and brigade per one source; the founders' blog says they chose it for owning the .com domain, ease of pronunciation and spelling, and searchability.
branding.domain_note: Owns frigade.com per founders' naming blog; the later AI product also uses frigade.ai.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer-first: build in code, launch with no-code

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches in Oct 2023 and Jul 2025, a Show HN post, and an open-source GitHub presence.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name with deliberate SEO work, though Google initially corrected it to frigate; moderate developer community visibility.

pivots.to: AI in-app agent for onboarding and support
pivots.why: Not stated; Product Hunt lists a separate Frigade AI launch on July 25, 2025.

outcome_analysis: Frigade raised a $3M seed in July 2023 led by Craft Ventures and La Famiglia, launched its onboarding product in October 2023, then moved toward an AI in-app assistant in 2025. No Series A, exit or shutdown was found, so it remains a small, active company in a market with established competitors.
